Boxes.Title: FEAT-0011 /abbd-setup find units with a reader swarm: Lists unit candidates from the layout and fans the reading out to a pstack swarm of how-explorer workers that report in the extraction format.

Boxes.Title: FEAT-0013 /abbd-setup write the reader supplement: Writes supplement.json with what only reading tells: purposes, units and couplings the script cannot see, and the grouping into parts.

Boxes.Name: /abbd-setup run setup and resolve refusals
Boxes.Title: FEAT-0014 /abbd-setup run setup and resolve refusals: Runs abbd setup with script and supplement, and says how to fix each refusal it can give.

Boxes.Name: /abbd-setup store how's account per module
Boxes.Title: FEAT-0015 /abbd-setup store how's account per module: For each top-level module, runs pstack how and stores its Overview and Key Concepts.

Boxes.Name: /abbd-setup verify, install and hand over
Boxes.Title: FEAT-0016 /abbd-setup verify, install and hand over: Checks the blueprint against the swarm's account, installs the CLAUDE.md block, commits, and hands ongoing work to the abbd skill.

Boxes.Name: /abbd-setup extraction format

Boxes.Name: CLAUDE.md abbd block
Boxes.Title: DATA-0001 CLAUDE.md abbd block: Defines the block text between <!-- abbd:begin --> and <!-- abbd:end -->, and the rule that a marker counts only alone on its line and outside fenced code, preserving the file's line endings.

Boxes.Name: review commands
Boxes.Title: MOD-0002 review commands: Owns diff against the units committed at a base revision with the --check boundary failure, the evidence live/dead report, and the status freshness and counts.

Boxes.Name: argv parsing and dispatch
Boxes.Title: MOD-0003 argv parsing and dispatch: Owns the command table walk: two-word verbs, the setup-only -- argv split, flags interspersed with positionals, the positional count check, and calling publish after a writing verb.

Boxes.Name: sync pipeline
Boxes.Title: MOD-0004 sync pipeline: Owns run script, parse, reconcile IDs across git renames, apply evidence, save units and candidates, then write state.yaml with a revision that moves only when the tree fingerprint does.

Boxes.Name: query commands
Boxes.Title: MOD-0005 query commands: Owns resolving a unit by ID, exact name or near name, and printing topology's explain, path and impact results with names, origins and how's CURRENT or STALE text.

Boxes.Name: record writers
Boxes.Title: MOD-0006 record writers: Owns record relation, record unit, record fact and understand: checking every quote against the tree, the origin precedence EXTRACTED over USER_STATED over INFERRED, the duplicate-code refusal, and refusing to restamp unchanged how text onto changed code.

Boxes.Name: blueprint publish
Boxes.Title: MOD-0007 blueprint publish: Owns loading the screen input with the current tree snapshot and writing index.html then graph.json, the watermark file last.

Boxes.Name: setup determinism proof and supplement fold
Boxes.Title: MOD-0008 setup determinism proof and supplement fold: Owns the three-run determinism proof (the third with reseeded PYTHONHASHSEED and PERL_HASH_SEED), reading the supplement relative to the root, and folding it over the script output before syncing with guesses replaced.
